title: Dread Eleven Confirms 2025–26 Pre-Season Squad Led by Captain Akhil Mishra
summary: Skipper Akhil Mishra convenes a 43-man tactical camp at Martand Ground ahead of the upcoming Atal Bihari Vajpayee Memorial Tournament cycle.
body:
Rewa — Dread Eleven (DE) have commenced their intensive pre-season tactical training at Martand Ground No. 3, confirming a 43-man roster spearheaded by veteran captain Akhil Mishra.

Holding a commanding 13–11 all-time advantage over rivals Destroyers Cricket Club (DES), Dread Eleven are focusing heavily on bowling discipline and powerplay containment.

"Our track record in Rewa speaks for itself," Mishra noted. "With Kuldeep Sen operating at peak velocity, Kumar Kartikeya controlling the middle overs, and Ashwin Das executing at the death, Dread Eleven possess the most balanced bowling attack in the division."

title: Championship Glory: Inside Dread Eleven’s 2022 Title Defense at APSU Stadium
summary: How disciplined bowling and tactical precision secured Dread Eleven the 2022 Atal Bihari Vajpayee Memorial Trophy.
body:
The 2022 Atal Bihari Vajpayee Memorial Tournament Final witnessed one of the most intense battles in Rewa cricket history, as Dread Eleven held off Destroyers in front of a capacity crowd at APSU Stadium.

Defending 183, Dread Eleven’s pace trio broke the opening partnership early. Despite resistance from Destroyers, Kuldeep Sen’s ferocious spell and Kumar Kartikeya’s economical four-over stranglehold clamped down the scoring, restricting Destroyers to 162/6 and sealing championship silverware for Dread Eleven.

title: Pace Battery: Kuldeep Sen and Ashwin Das Set Tournament Pace Benchmark
summary: An in-depth analysis of Dread Eleven’s pace attack and their match-winning strike rates across 24 derby clashes.
body:
With 28 wickets combined across derby encounters, the tandem of Kuldeep Sen and Ashwin Das has established itself as the premier fast-bowling partnership in the Atal Bihari Vajpayee Tournament.

Sen’s ability to generate steep bounce from a hard length on the APSU Stadium turf complements Das’s pinpoint yorkers and slower ball variations in the slog overs.

title: Captain’s Log: Akhil Mishra Crosses 900 Runs with 47.6 Average
summary: A statistical tribute to Dread Eleven skipper Akhil Mishra, whose consistency has anchored 19 derby fixtures.
body:
Dread Eleven captain Akhil Mishra has entered elite territory, amassing 905 runs across 19 matches against Destroyers Cricket Club with 9 half-centuries to his credit.

Averaging 47.6 runs per innings, Mishra’s reliability at number three has formed the bedrock of Dread Eleven’s 13 derby victories in Rewa.
